paper_title: Don’t Jump Through Hoops and Remove Those Loops: SVRG and Katyusha are Better Without the Outer Loop
authors: Dmitry Kovalev, Samuel Horváth, Peter Richtárik
statement: 5. Numerical Experiments In this section, we perform experiments with logistic regression for binary classification with L2 µ 2 regularizer, where our loss function has the form fi (x) = log(1 + exp(−bi a>i x)) + 2 kxk , where ai ∈ Rd , bi ∈ {−1, +1}, i ∈ [n]. Hence, f is smooth and µ-strongly convex. We use four LIBSVM library2 : a9a, w8a, mushrooms, phishing, cod-rna. We compare our methods L-SVRG and L-Katyusha with their original version. It is wellknown that whenever practical, SAGA is a bit faster than SVRG. While a comparison to SAGA seems natural as it also does not have a double loop structure, we position our loopless methods for applications where the high memory requirements of SAGA prevent it to be applied.
